article.headline: Murray State beats Tennessee State 94-64 as Roman Domon scores 22
article.description: — Roman Domon scored 22 points as Murray State beat Tennessee State 94-64 on Monday.
article.linkText: Murray State beats Tennessee State 94-64 as Roman Domon scores 22

categories.description: Murray State Racers @ Tennessee State Tigers

event.description: Murray State Racers @ Tennessee State Tigers

keywords: Murray State Racers @ Tennessee State Tigers
article.story: SIOUX FALLS, S.D. -- — Roman Domon scored 22 points as Murray State beat Tennessee State 94-64 on Monday. Domon also contributed five rebounds for the Racers (1-0). Kaden Magwood scored 15 points, shooting 5 for 8 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line. Brayden Shorter went 5 of 9 from the field (3 for 7 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. Ty-Laur Johnson led the Tigers (0-1) in scoring, finishing with 15 points, four assists and two steals. Tennessee State also got 10 points from Deondrea Lindsey. Christian Alston finished with eight points. Murray State took the lead with 13:28 remaining in the first half and did not trail again.
